passages.text:
Re: tomorrow's meeting
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Monday, September 12, 2022 at 3:01:59PM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [opaque block] [contact omitted] Maurer, Tim EOP/NSC
Cc: [contact omitted] Lorri Anne Meils, [contact omitted] Lisa Poggiali
hi! I'll provide this here adn for Lorri as well. These are bilateral USAID - tech mtgs on specific issues.
On Mon, Sep 12, 2022 at 12:00 PM Maurer, Tim EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera,
Thank you. Lorri, please make sure to include that in the updates tomorrow, including (a) level of participation in
engagement with tech company and (b) who beyond USAID across the interagency has been invited to the meeting.
We have asked GEC et al to do the same.
Best,
Tim
From: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, September 12, 2022 2:58 PM
To: Maurer, Tim EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Lisa Poggiali <[contact omitted]>; Lorri Anne Meils <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: tomorrow's meeting
Separately, our Europe team has requested a call with on JIGSAW Euro disinfo pilot project. That is now happening on
Wednesday.
I'm following up with Josh Blumenfeld separately later this week at YT - he owes feedback back to me on these creator
trainings, etc... so more to follow once I know more.
On Mon, Sep 12, 2022 at 11:55 AM Maurer, Tim EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera,
Many thanks for the update and heads up. We look forward to the readout from the Northern triangle task force
meeting with Twitter.
Best,
Tim

From: Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Monday, September 12, 2022 2:19 PM
To: Maurer, Tim EOP/NSC < [opaque block] [contact omitted]>
Cc: Lisa Poggiali <[contact omitted]>; Lorri Anne Meils <[contact omitted]>
Subject: tomorrow's meeting
Hey Tim,
How are you?
I'm not going to be at the meeting tomorrow morning for the huddle. Lorri will join on our behalf. Lisa will also be out.
I wanted to provide you a couple of updates on Tech.
Our northern triangle task force met with Twitter last week. I was on the call. It was a first meeting, so the feel was to
see what Twitter is doing in this space in the region. Notes are forthcoming, but it was an introductory call.
The call with You Tube and our OTI team for Ukr/ Moldova on training influencers has been postponed.
I reached back out to Meta, as they owe Johnny and me some due outs, but nothing yet.
Lorri will update tomorrow on everything else, but it's more of the main big items we have been discussing.
cheers and happy to chat / meet whenever you like.
Vera
Vera Zakem
Senior Technology and Democracy Advisor
U.S. Agency for International Development / DRG
Email: [contact omitted]
[opaque block]
